text: 你猛地扑倒在地，避开迎面驶来的汽车。你脸朝下摔进已经有几英寸深的积水里。汽车从你身边疾驰而过，你迅速翻身爬起，全身湿透。
你再次沮丧地望向埃斯伯里，那里正迅速被淹。浓雾中几乎什么也看不清，但在黑暗中，你看见火焰明亮地燃烧着。雾气使火焰的色彩显得黯淡，但它们比周围的阴影明亮得多。
你想不出一座正在沉没的城镇为什么会着火，但脑海里编出的各种解释都不能让你安心。你没有停留太久。就在你为处境感到绝望时，浓雾紧紧包围了你，另有某种更令人作呕的东西也靠近了。一只绿色、松软的手抓住你的手臂，开始粗暴地把你拖向镇子。你尽力挣扎，却发现自己无法轻易挣脱。你必须更有力地反抗。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 191
text: You throw yourself to the ground, making sure you avoid the oncoming car. You land face-first in water that’s already several inches deep. You roll over quickly as the car speeds past you, and you rise from the ground soaking wet.

You look in dismay once again toward Esbury, which is flooding fast. You can make out little through the fog, but amid the darkness, you can see flames burning bright. The colors are muted by the mist but are significantly brighter than the surrounding shadows.

You can think of no reason why a sinking town would be on fire, but whatever excuses your head conjures up are not comforting. You do not stand to ponder on it long. As you despair over your circumstances, the mist closes in tightly around you, as does something more unsavory. A green, flabby hand seizes your arm and begins pulling you violently toward the town. You struggle against the grasp as best you can, but you find you cannot easily slip away. A more purposeful application of force is required.
